entities.summary: Narayan Hemchandra Divecha (1855–1904), commonly known as Narayan Hemchandra, was a Gujarati writer, translator and critic. He travelled extensively and wrote autobiography, novels, stories and criticism. He was a prolific translator and credited with introducing Bengali literature to Gujarat.
